desc: Fix class-level mutable state in KnowledgeBaseDocuments
context: app/knowledge/documents.py line 26 declares _document_stores: InMemoryEmbeddingsDB = None as a CLASS attribute, not an instance attribute (smell-03). This means all instances share the same reference, which is misleading and risks shared-state bugs. Move the declaration from class body into __init__() as self._document_stores = None before the conditional that sets it. The __init__ already conditionally assigns it, so only the class-level declaration needs to move.
acceptance_criteria: _document_stores is not declared at the class level in KnowledgeBaseDocuments
_document_stores is initialized as self._document_stores in __init__ before any conditional
All tests pass: cd app && poetry run pytest -x --ignore=tests/test_server.py
